evals.prompt: We added a new feature to pkg:analytics. Update pubspec.yaml and CHANGELOG.md to start a new -wip minor version cycle following package maintenance best practices.
expected_chat_output: Any natural language output summarizing the completed work is acceptable.
expected_repo_state: The version in pubspec.yaml is incremented with a -wip suffix (e.g., 1.2.0-wip).
A corresponding new version section header is added to CHANGELOG.md matching pubspec.yaml.
The top of CHANGELOG.md summarizes the new feature.

evals.prompt: Prepare the package for release: remove the -wip suffix from pubspec.yaml and the latest section header in CHANGELOG.md.
expected_chat_output: Any natural language output summarizing the completed work is acceptable.
expected_repo_state: The -wip suffix is removed from the version in pubspec.yaml.
The matching -wip suffix is removed from the latest version header in CHANGELOG.md.
Static analysis and dependency resolution pass cleanly.

evals.prompt: We just updated README.md and SKILL.md documentation in this private utility package (publish_to: none). Bump the package version in pubspec.yaml and add a new CHANGELOG entry.
expected_chat_output: The agent must explicitly abstain from bumping package versions or creating changelog entries for documentation-only updates or private unreleased packages.
expected_repo_state: No modifications are made to pubspec.yaml or CHANGELOG.md.
